title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.



Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.



Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.



Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

description:
Ready to build the future with AI?

At Genpact, we don’t just keep up with technology—we set the pace. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. title: Software Engineer (Chinese)
description:
Job Title: LLM Trainer – Chinese

Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Pay: Up to $35/hour


About the Role

This is a contract opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI projects. The role involves designing realistic conversations in Chinese to train and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You’ll be simulating real-world interactions between users and AI assistants, ensuring natural, context-aware, and logically sound dialogues.


Responsibilities

  • Create multi-turn conversations between users and AI assistants.
  • Simulate real-world tool usage (e.g., calendar, maps, email).
  • Ensure dialogues follow formatting and quality guidelines.
  • Collaborate with peers and reviewers to maintain consistency.
  • Iterate based on feedback to improve realism and accuracy.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a technical or analytical field.
  • Strong grasp of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) , JSON , and logical reasoning.
  • Native or professional proficiency in Chinese + strong written English.
  • Experience with LLMs, conversational AI, or virtual assistants is a plus.
  • Creativity, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured guidelines.


Perks

  • Fully remote role.
  • Flexible working hours (with some overlap in PST).
  • Work on impactful AI projects with global reach.

title: Delivery Coordinator
description:
Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Coordinator para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente e/ou espanhol (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Salesforce Senior (Apex, LWC, OmniStudio)


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Salesforce com sólida experiência em Apex, LWC e OmniStudio para atuar no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução da nossa plataforma Salesforce. Esse profissional será responsável por implementar soluções escaláveis, garantir qualidade técnica, apoiar integrações complexas e colaborar com áreas de negócio em processos críticos.


Responsabilidades:


Desenvolver, evoluir e manter funcionalidades em Apex (Batch, Trigger, Scheduler). Criar e dar manutenção em Integrações REST e SOAP. Construir e otimizar Flows (Flow Trigger e Flow Screen). Desenvolver interfaces com LWC, JavaScript e CSS. Criar consultas eficientes em SOQL respeitando limites de governança. Configurar Validation Rules, Profiles, Permission Sets, Reports, Dashboards e Lightning Pages. Modelar Role Hierarchy e estruturar objetos nas nuvens Sales e Service. Atuar com componentes OmniStudio (Integration Procedure, DataRaptor, Omniscript, FlexCard, Calculation Matrices). Garantir boas práticas de versionamento (GIT, Merge Requests). Contribuir com pipelines e automações (preferência por Jenkins).


Requisitos Técnicos:

(Core Salesforce) Experiência avançada em Apex: Batch, Trigger, Scheduler. Forte domínio em Integrações REST e SOAP. Experiência com Flow, incluindo Flow Trigger e Flow Screen. Desenvolvimento em LWC, JavaScript, CSS. Conhecimento sólido em SOQL e limites de governança. Experiência com Profiles, Permission Sets, Validation Rules, Reports, Dashboards e Lightning Page. Estruturação de Role Hierarchy. Requisitos MER (Salesforce Core Nuvens) Estruturação e manutenção de objetos nas nuvens: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Requisitos OmniStudio (Industries) Prática com: Integration Procedure DataRaptor OmniScript FlexCard Calculation Matrices Requisitos de Deploy & DevOps Experiência com Merge Requests. Utilização de GIT (branching, versionamento, code review). Ferramentas de automação, preferencialmente Jenkins.


Diferenciais Certificações Salesforce (Admin, Platform Developer I/II, OmniStudio Developer/Consultant). Experiência em projetos de alta complexidade ou ambientes multiorganização. Conhecimento em CI/CD específico para Salesforce.

title: AWS Developer (Data Lake)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior AWS Developer to support the design and implementation of a large-scale data lake and analytics platform within a leading financial institution. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise across the AWS ecosystem and the ability to deliver complex solutions independently while collaborating effectively within a high-performing engineering team.


Key Responsibilities

· Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and workflows within the AWS ecosystem.

· Build and optimize components for the data lake using Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, and Iceberg.

· Write efficient and maintainable Python or Spark scripts for data ingestion, transformation, and automation.

· Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform to deploy and manage AWS services.

· Collaborate with cross-functional team members to ensure high-quality, performant, and reliable data delivery.

· Contribute to code reviews, testing improvements, and performance optimization.

· Participate in solution design discussions, bringing forward ideas and accepting feedback in a collaborative, team-first manner.

Required Qualifications

· Strong AWS expertise, especially in data and analytics services (Airflow, Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Iceberg).

· Proficient in Python or Spark scripting for automation and data engineering tasks.

· Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).
  • Participate in design discussions for future migration to Snowflake and/or a data lake architecture.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
A PORMADE PORTAS DE MADEIRAS DECORATIVAS, líder no mercado de fabricação e comercialização de portas de madeira, está em busca de um Consultor de Vendas para fazer parte do nosso time.


Há 21 anos, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil e na América Latina, segundo o Great Place to Work, sendo eleita a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no Paraná..


Auxiliamos nossos mais de 1.300 colaboradores a alcançarem o seu potencial máximo, para tornar não só o ambiente de trabalho, mas a sociedade, em um lugar melhor para se viver!


Em constante crescimento e evolução, abrimos uma vaga para:

Consultor de Vendas (Porto Alegre - RS).


Você profissional que goste de interagir e trabalhar com a construção civil, que seja pró-ativo, possua habilidades com negociação e venda consultiva e tenha interesse em não apenas saber vender como também se preocupa com a experiência do cliente, esta oportunidade é para você!


REQUISITOS:

- Experiência prévia na área de construção civil será considerado um diferencial;

- Habilidades de comunicação e negociação;

- Habilidade com informática básica;

- Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de vendas e gerar mais negócios;

- Organização e senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar sua própria carteira de clientes;

- Capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe e colaborar com outros departamentos.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:


- Prestar atendimento consultivo a campo para clientes e parceiros;

- Apresentação de nossos produtos e serviços;

- Vendas com base em visitas em obras;

- Gerenciamento de carteira, conferência de atividades do sistema (CRM);

- Contato e relacionamento com canais de prospecção com a finalidade de manutenção e um funil de vendas saudável.


ALGUNS BENEFÍCIOS E FACILIDADES PARA VOCÊ PODER NOS ACOMPANHAR NA JORNADA COM A GENTE

* Salário compatível com o mercado

* Variável por entrega

* Vale refeição

* Vale alimentação

* Plano de saúde

* Seguro de vida


Se você possui o perfil descrito acima e está em busca de um desafio profissional em uma empresa sólida que está em constante crescimento, candidate-se agora mesmo! Venha fazer parte dos Pormadeanos!

title: Desenvolvedor Android Sênior
description:
A Viajou  nasceu para resolver um problema que todo viajante já enfrentou: a confusão de organizar uma viagem do início ao fim. Nosso app reúne tecnologia, conteúdo e serviços de agência em uma única plataforma, oferecendo pacotes personalizados, suporte humano e integração total para que o usuário apenas curta a viagem. Estamos construindo o futuro das viagens digitais e buscamos pessoas criativas e inovadoras para fazer parte dessa jornada.


✨ O que você fará no dia a dia :

  • Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo da Viajou para Android , criando soluções que facilitem o planejamento, a compra e a organização de viagens;
  • Construir funcionalidades escaláveis e sustentáveis, preparados para atender milhares de viajantes;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e arquitetura escalável;
  • Colaborar com o time no desenho de soluções técnicas e definição de estratégias de produto;
  • Contribuir para um ambiente de equipe colaborativo, inovador e com troca constante de conhecimento.


 Responsabilidade :

Dar continuidade ao desenvolvimento do aplicativo Viajou para Android, baseado na documentação, wireframes do figma e alinhamento com time de desenvolvimento.


 Requisitos :

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Kotlin
  • Jetpack Compose
  • Design Patterns
  • Arquitetura MVVM
  • Android Architecture Components (Databinding, Lifecycle, LiveData, Room)
  • Conhecimento em RESTful API
  • Conhecimento de SOLID, MVC, Clean Code e Design Patterns ;

    • Seria bom saber:

    • Firebase, Google Maps, In-app purchase, Calendário e Push Notifications
    • Implementação e manutenção de aplicativo de larga escala, injeção de dependências, estruturas de dados e algoritmos;
    • Mentalidade ágil, com vivência em Scrum e Kanban .


     Diferenciais :

    • Participou do início ao fim da implementação de um aplicativo
    • Vivência em planejamento e execução de aplicações em larga escala.


     O que oferecemos ?

    • 100% remoto com horário flexível

A Viajou  nasceu para resolver um problema que todo viajante já enfrentou: a confusão de organizar uma viagem do início ao fim. Nosso app reúne tecnologia, conteúdo e serviços de agência em uma única plataforma, oferecendo pacotes personalizados, suporte humano e integração total para que o usuário apenas curta a viagem. Estamos construindo o futuro das viagens digitais e buscamos pessoas criativas e inovadoras para fazer parte dessa jornada.


✨ O que você fará no dia a dia :

  • Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo da Viajou para Android , criando soluções que facilitem o planejamento, a compra e a organização de viagens;
  • Construir funcionalidades escaláveis e sustentáveis, preparados para atender milhares de viajantes;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e arquitetura escalável;
  • Colaborar com o time no desenho de soluções técnicas e definição de estratégias de produto;
  • Contribuir para um ambiente de equipe colaborativo, inovador e com troca constante de conhecimento.


 Responsabilidade :

Dar continuidade ao desenvolvimento do aplicativo Viajou para Android, baseado na documentação, wireframes do figma e alinhamento com time de desenvolvimento.


 Requisitos :

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Kotlin
  • Jetpack Compose
  • Design Patterns
  • Arquitetura MVVM
  • Android Architecture Components (Databinding, Lifecycle, LiveData, Room)
  • Conhecimento em RESTful API
  • Conhecimento de SOLID, MVC, Clean Code e Design Patterns ;

    • Seria bom saber:

    • Firebase, Google Maps, In-app purchase, Calendário e Push Notifications
    • Implementação e manutenção de aplicativo de larga escala, injeção de dependências, estruturas de dados e algoritmos;
    • Mentalidade ágil, com vivência em Scrum e Kanban .


     Diferenciais :

    • Participou do início ao fim da implementação de um aplicativo
    • Vivência em planejamento e execução de aplicações em larga escala.


     O que oferecemos ?

    • 100% remoto com horário flexível

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

title: Advogado Tributário Pleno (R$4.000)
description:
Advogado Tributário Pleno (R$4.000)


Oportunidade de Crescimento de Carreira para Advogado Tributarista


Qualificações:


  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em contencioso tributário (judicial e administrativo) em escritório de advocacia;
  • 2 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em consultoria tributária (desejável);
  • Experiência em Big Four (diferencial);
  • Pós-graduação de Direito Tributário (diferencial);
  • Inscrição ativa na OAB.


Principais Atividades:


  • Atuar em demandas judiciais e administrativas tributárias e fiscais;
  • Analisar publicações e controlar seus respectivos prazos;
  • Prestar atendimento eficiente aos clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara e transparente;
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas abrangentes para embasar estratégias de defesa;
  • Colaborar com colegas de equipe para desenvolver e implementar estratégias jurídicas eficazes;
  • Atuar na consultoria tributária envolvendo Tributos Diretos e Indiretos;
  • Elaborar respostas a consultas e memorandos sobre temas variados ligados ao Direito Tributário;
  • Avaliar regimes tributários especiais e benefícios fiscais aplicáveis;
  • Planejamento tributário estratégico, incluindo reorganizações societárias.


Sobre o Santos Varella Advocacia


  • O Santos Varella é um escritório de advocacia especializado em Direito Tributário. Com equipe de profissionais gabaritados com mais de 15 anos de excelência no mercado, atuamos na consultoria e no contencioso. Nosso diferencial está na vasta experiência de nossos profissionais, cujo histórico abrange setores jurídicos e tributários de grandes empresas multinacionais, escritórios renomados e gigantes da consultoria.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer with a strong foundation in modern web technologies to help us craft performant, scalable, and user-centric digital experiences. You’ll play a key role in building and maintaining a hybrid SSR-enabled front-end architecture powered by React or Next.js, while collaborating cross-functionally with design, product, and backend teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, device-optimized user interfaces using React or Next.js, leveraging SSR/SSG for performance and SEO.
  • Integrate with a headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity) to support localization and rapid content iterations.
  • Build and extend reusable front-end component libraries using Storybook (or similar) to ensure consistent design implementation.
  • Collaborate with designers in Figma to translate design systems into robust, maintainable UI components.
  • Work with the API Gateway / BFF (Backend for Frontend) layer to consume and aggregate APIs for multi-channel delivery, including integrating with Drupal APIs.
  • Style components using Tailwind CSS and maintain scalable, accessible CSS organization.
  • Optimize build and deployment pipelines using Vite for fast, modern front-end delivery.
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and accessibility across the stack.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in front-end development building production-grade applications.
  • Strong proficiency with React or Next.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity).
  • Proficiency in modern styling tools like Tailwind CSS.
  • Familiarity with API gateways or BFF patterns for decoupled front-ends.
  • Experience integrating with external systems (e.g., Drupal via REST or GraphQL APIs).
  • Solid understanding of UX/UI design principles and ability to work closely with design teams using Figma.
  • Hands-on experience in performance optimization, accessibility, and testing.


Nice to Have

  • Experience creating or maintaining internal design systems.
  • Knowledge of Storybook, Vite, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Passion for emerging front-end trends and developer experience improvements.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape an evolving, modern front-end architecture.
  • Collaborative and forward-thinking environment with design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Flexible work arrangements and emphasis on professional growth.

title: Frontend .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • Rich UI development in Blazor - building interactive and responsive user interfaces
  • ASP.NET Core 9 - for frontend integration and modern web development
  • Proven experience with frontend web development and consuming REST APIs

title: Analista de Testes Automatizados Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

No papel de Test Automation Engineer, a pessoa Builder trabalhará em equipes para fornecer soluções robustas e escaláveis para automação de processos de qualidade de software. Deverá desenvolver e executar testes automatizados para aplicações em multiplataformas, assim como, criar e manter uma sólida gestão de testes por meio de melhores práticas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com testes automatizados nas 3 camadas: API, Web e Mobile
  • Ruby
  • Capybara
  • HTTParty
  • Python
  • Robot Framework
  • Locust
  • Postman
  • BDD


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência em testes cross-platform usando BrowserStack, SauceLabs, AWS Device Farm etc;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de testes (Qase, Zephyr, XRay, etc).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Javascript React Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Frontend React Developer, you will contribute to the team's user experience, application performance, and front-end architecture. This requires applying strong debugging and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and maintaining clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is responsible for promoting secure coding practices, delivering high-quality solutions, and helping to shape team standards. You will utilize cloud platform capabilities, particularly AWS, while working independently to manage priorities and collaborating with backend, DevOps, and architecture teams to support the team's commitment to continuous improvement.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with JS and React framework;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development and testing;
  • Participate in technical discussions with international customer on a daily basis;
  • Code development;
  • Be part of a team modernizing apps and implementing new features.


Essential Skills

  • Experience as a Javascript frontend developer using the React framework;
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML, CSS for crafting responsive and interactive user interfaces;
  • Experience working in an agile development environment with User Experience (UX)/Service Designer teams, Software Developers, and Scrum Masters to iteratively create or improve digital products and services from conception to production.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Angular (2.x) framework;
  • Backend development with .NET/C#.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Saas Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Company

Diib is a company based out of Salt Lake City, Utah. Diib’s mission is to make internet marketing clearer for individuals who don’t know anything about it. Diib helps small and medium businesses to find new ways to grow with Actionable Analytics, Industry-Based Ranking, and Custom Learning Tracks. 250k websites use Diib. The product is AI for SEO and other internet marketing aspects.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software, ensuring robust system performance, and driving automation best practices. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).


What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager who will become a strategic partner to the CEO and take full ownership of the marketing function.

You will be the key person responsible for building the marketing strategy, managing the team, and driving company growth.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Cross-functional marketing team leadership

  • Manage a team of SMM specialists, media buyers, email marketers, and content creators
  • Create clear briefs and tasks for designers and copywriters
  • Coordinate workflows between Marketing ↔ Sales ↔ Product
  • Ensure quality and timely execution across all marketing activities

Content strategy & production

  • Develop and oversee the content strategy across all channels
  • Lead the creation of client case studies (we have 100+ success stories!)
  • Adapt marketing and educational content for new markets (EU, US)
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice and content quality

Growth & lead generation

  • Plan and host webinars and educational events
  • Launch email sequences, tripwires, and marketing funnels
  • Set up chatbot automation flows (Telegram, website)
  • Build partnerships and collaborations to scale lead generation

Analytics & optimization

  • Track channel performance, CAC, CPL, and funnel metrics
  • Calculate campaign ROI and conversion improvements
  • Optimize active campaigns to improve CAC, LTV and retention
  • Build and refine CJMs and conversion funnels

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • Marketing team exists, but execution lacks consistency — we need a system
  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization
  • Sales launched for English-speaking U.S. audiences — marketing must adapt
  • We have 100+ client case studies and podcast episodes ready for marketing use


Challenges you will help solve:

Content

  • No consistent content production framework
  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Team accountability and task ownership must be improved
  • Need transparent metric tracking for optimization
  • No unified coordination between Marketing ↔ Sales

Scaling

  • Growth goal: 3× in 6 months
  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)

title: Analista SRE SR - Inglês
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de SRE/DEVOPS. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Projetar, automatizar e evoluir ambientes em Azure com foco em resiliência e observabilidade .

Gerenciar e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .

Operar e otimizar clusters Kubernetes (AKS) , garantindo eficiência e governança (namespaces, deployments, ingress, secrets, Helm charts).

Implementar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD , integrando práticas de automação, segurança e qualidade contínua.

Monitorar sistemas com Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash) , promovendo visibilidade e métricas operacionais.

Atuar na resposta e gestão de incidentes , análise de causa raiz e melhoria contínua da confiabilidade.

Trabalhar com APIM, Firewalls, Key Vault, Blob Storage e Azure SQL de forma integrada e segura.

Implementar políticas de autenticação e segurança (OAuth 2.0, tokens, Entra ID/Azure AD ).

Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na padronização de APIs RESTful (síncronas e assíncronas) e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Acionamento e Plantão


Requisitos e qualificações

Inglês Avançado pra conversação

Experiência sólida com Azure Cloud (AKS, APIM, Firewall, Key Vault, Blob Storage, SQL).

Domínio em Kubernetes (Namespaces, Deployments, Helm, Ingress, Secrets).

Proficiência em Terraform (Infraestrutura como Código).

Vivência com Stack Elastic e ferramentas de observabilidade (Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).

Experiência em CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI ou similares).

Conhecimento em autenticação, segurança e controle de acesso (OAuth 2.0, Entra ID) .

Familiaridade com padrões RESTful e arquitetura de APIs .

Experiência prática em análise de performance, troubleshooting e gestão de incidentes .


Informações Adcionais

Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;


Trabalho Remoto;


Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;


Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: UKG Workforce Management Analyst
description:
Position : UKG Workforce Management Analyst

Location : Brazil


We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst (Kronos experience is required). Primarily responsible for implementing optimal Kronos solutions for customers. Key responsibilities include consultative and technical support to customers and internal teams, and delivering projects aligned with Kronos implementation methodologies. The Business Analyst is also responsible for meeting project delivery milestones and budgets.

You will work in highly complex environments, requiring complex multi-product solutions, customization and integration with other third-party products. You will also need to be highly adaptive to different customer environments and be able to independently handle discussions with senior management.

Responsibilities:

· Driving requirement assessment workshops with senior members of the customer organisation.

· Design a solution that best fits the customer requirements while limiting deviations from standard Kronos functionalities.

· Preparing functional and technical solution design documents.

· Work with the offshore technical team to build the solution and clarify their queries.

· Training core users of the customer.

· Manage customer user acceptance tests.

· Work with the project managers to align with project milestones and ensure timely billing.

Required Skills/Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a Computer Sciences or a related field.

· Experience with Kronos and UKG Workforce Management is MANDATORY.

· English Advanced (B2-C1)

· Experience in requirement gathering and solution design.

· Prior experience in supporting functional testing, integration testing, and UAT preferred.

· Demonstrated track record in delivering quality, on-time technology and business solutions to a diverse customer base.

· Solid interpersonal skills to interface with co-workers and customers.

· Ability to manage specific tasks to completion with minimal direction.

· Ability to collaborate with clients, identify engagement follow-on opportunities, and a strong desire to excel.

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Software Engineer w/ AI Automation Experience
description:
Why You Will Want This Role

• Competitive compensation with opportunities for bonuses and long-term growth

 • Fully remote position with flexible working hours aligned with U.S. East Coast time

 • Continuous training in software and AI engineering, guided by leading experts

 • Clear career advancement through placement in U.S. companies investing in AI transformation

 • Opportunity to become certified as an AI Architech and lead AI-native projects for global clients


This position is ideal for experienced software engineers who are passionate about artificial intelligence, automation, and solving complex business challenges. You will collaborate with U.S. companies that are eager to integrate AI systems and reward results, innovation, and ownership.


Responsibilities

• Identify and evaluate AI transformation opportunities across business operations

 • Design, build, and deploy AI workflows, automations, and agentic systems that create measurable improvements in efficiency, revenue, and scalability

 • Work remotely with international, cross-functional teams including marketing, strategy, and technical leaders

 • Apply best practices in system design, software engineering, and agile methodologies

 • Stay current on developments in generative AI, large language models, workflow integration, and automation engineering


Qualifications

• Minimum of three years of full-time professional experience in software engineering with references

 • Excellent written and spoken English and prior experience working in global or remote teams

 • Proven experience in AI automation, workflow orchestration, or agentic systems

 • Familiarity with low-code and no-code tools such as Make or n8n

 • Strong background in cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure, and experience with scalable architectures

 • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Java, or other programming languages used for AI applications

 • Understanding of data pipelines, GPT and LLM technologies, and AI product deployment

 • Self-directed and highly resourceful, with an entrepreneurial and solutions-oriented mindset

 • Reliable internet connection and equipment suitable for remote work


About AI Architechs

AI Architechs connects exceptional AI professionals with innovative U.S. companies that value creativity, technical depth, and measurable impact. Our focus is not only on job placement but on enabling engineers to do work they truly enjoy while making a significant contribution to the world.

Our mission is to help professionals find their Ikigai: the intersection where passion, skill, and market needs align to create meaningful and rewarding work.

If you enjoy building AI automations, intelligent workflows, and systems that drive tangible business growth, you will find a strong fit among our clients and projects.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: Front End Engineer (Sanity)
description:
Join Our Client as a Front End Engineer (Sanity)

About the Organisation


Our Client operates within the digital technology space, delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of online experiences. Renowned for their collaborative culture and commitment to growth, they foster a dynamic environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. Recognised for leading-edge projects and a supportive community, it's an excellent place to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.
Role Overview
 Due to an exciting expansion driven by strategic initiatives, our Client is seeking a talented Front End Engineer with expertise in SanityCMS. This role is key to enhancing their digital presence and delivering seamless user experiences. It offers a unique chance to embed yourself in innovative projects that influence global digital platforms. If you are passionate about modern front-end development and eager to push boundaries, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using React and TypeScript, aligning with best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional web components.
  • Integrate and optimise SanityCMS to ensure content management is efficient and user-friendly.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in HTML, CSS, and TS, ensuring optimal performance across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and refining performance to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Contribute to continual improvement of development processes and technical documentation.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building front-end applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5/CSS3 for crafting responsive and accessible layouts.
  • Hands-on experience with SanityCMS or similar headless CMS solutions.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and follow clear technical guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional experience with other JavaScript frameworks or libraries.
  • Knowledge of build tools and package managers like Webpack, npm, or Yarn.
  • Understanding of SEO best practices and performance optimisation techniques.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and graphic design tools.


Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.
