title: SAP Integration Lead (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Integration Lead

We are looking for a consultant able to lead integration processes accross all levels of our client's environment, in contact with stakeholders and also with outside partners.

Together with the leading skills and understanding of the business, the ideal profile would have a strong technical background in SAP SD; SAP ABAP; SAP Order-to-Cash and EDI & Idoc Integration.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide solution architect leadership & strategy development.
  • Lead Technical architect for medium to large projects.
  • Accountable across multiple functional and technical areas with wide range of complexity.
  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.
  • Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture to make sure that the solution fits within enterprise context, while also ensures solutions align with business goals and processes, and follow client's IT Standards and Best Practices.
  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.
  • Coordinates complex solution architecture implementations while leading design variances based upon business needs. Ensures artifacts are documented.
  • Coordinates engagements with internal and external parties as they relate to evaluation, design and delivery of business capabilities.
  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.
  • Participant in industry representation, policy formation, User Groups, and strategic direction.
  • Provides coaching and leadership to system software developers through enhancements and projects.
  • Works well with varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).
  • Able to understand business requirements to turn into technical specification solutions.
  • Stay abreast of latest technologies in his/her functional space, consistently growing in knowledge and industry trends.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years IT professional work experience.
  • Mandatory to have excellent fluency in English; both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Candidate will be regarded as SME and should have high level of expertise in SAP - SD component.
  • Strong ABAP skills, with complex troubleshooting experience.
  • SAP Order-to-Cash end to end expertise required (SD).
  • EDI and Idoc experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in software engineering, software development, solution architecture and able to develop a High Level Design (HLD) and ideally with ability to deliver Low Level Designs within area of expertise.
  • Experience in highly integrated complex data environments e.g. EDI/ BI/ ETL, ERP etc, and open to working in a multitude of SAP and NonSAP applications and technologies.
  • Candidate should possess high level of consultative skills and have prior experience of collaborating with Business Analysts and Enterprise Architects in solving complex business problems with innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking
  • Self-motivated and self-starting on work
  • Strong Technical leadership of Application Development teams and vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and methodologies
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can quickly cultivate networking opportunities within the organization at varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Broad range of business and IT experiences
  • Hold technical and/or business certification(s).
  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech
HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.
To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.
About the Role
As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.
Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required. What You’ll Gain
Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 17 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista QA - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mapeamento, escrita de cenários e execução com Appium
  • Testes em dispositivos móveis físicos e emuladores
  • Automação com Selenium
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de automações em Python
  • Execução e validação de APIs via Postman/Insomnia
  • Utilização de Git em times ágeis
  • Utilização de BDD (Gherkin)


Conhecimentos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

  • Criação ou utilização de relatórios de testes (Allure, etc.)

  • Integração de automação em pipelines (CI/CD)
  • Criação de mocks ou ambientes de teste para APIs

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Account Executive (LATAM)
description:
*Resume MUST be in English


Location: LATAM

Role: Account Executive (LATAM)

Department: Sales

Mode: Full-time


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, Respond.io is a pioneering Business Messaging platform that seamlessly unifies customer communication across instant messaging, web chat, and email. Our excellence has been recognized by G2 and honoured with the SME100 Award, underscoring our rapid growth and innovative solutions. Operating in 127 countries and dominating key markets in LATAM, EMEA, and APAC, we serve an impressive roster of industry-leading clients.


Our workforce is a testament to our global reach, with remote workforce and employees from all around the world, contributing to our diverse and inclusive culture. At Respond.io, we are not just a platform—we are a movement, pushing the boundaries of customer communication for tech-savvy organizations worldwide. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of business messaging!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Sales are pivotal to our company’s success. As a sales personnel, you will be using proactive and inbound selling strategies to engage with mid to large-size businesses to close new business. You will use your knowledge of handling B2B sales to identify business opportunities with current leads and prospective key clients.


We are looking for a Account Executive to join our Sales team and focus on our Mid Market customers across LATAM. This segment represents a huge opportunity for respond.io and we want someone who is eager to do the best work of their lives while supporting others in doing the same.


You will be responsible for driving the sales process with prospective customers as well as expansion within existing accounts. You will work closely with our customers to understand their business goals and act as their trusted guide to understanding how respond.io would be a good fit in their organization. You'll also work with cross-functional teams to help align our product roadmap and marketing materials with customer feedback. If you enjoy working with customers from a variety of industries in a rapidly changing environment, then come and join us!


Responsibilities

  • Be the driving force behind our revenue growth by proactively seeking new opportunities.
  • Educate potential customers on the immense value that respond.io offers.
  • Provide tailored solution recommendations based on customers' unique business needs and usage patterns.
  • Manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously, guiding them through various stages of the sales process.
  • Handle inbound customer inquiries with finesse, effectively addressing billing, legal, security, and technical concerns.
  • Act as the advocate for our customers, collecting valuable feedback to fuel ongoing improvements, including product enhancements.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies to effectively position the company’s products in the market.
  • Assist with additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to contribute to the team's success.


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS sales is a must.
  • Exceptional proficiency in clear and concise spoken and written English and Spanish is essential.
  • A track record of successfully closing sales deals within a B2B SaaS company is highly preferred.
  • You're passionate about identifying customer needs and ensuring their satisfaction.
  • An ambitious and goal-driven mindset is crucial for success.
  • Good communication skills in English and Spanish with an ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • You thrive in a flexible and dynamic environment, showing resilience in the face of challenges.


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Remote

Must follow and support US time zones

Enterprise Architect


Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Economics, Sociology, or another related field.
  • 8+ years of IT experience required.
  • 4+ years of architecture experience in multiple architectural domains such as business, information, application, integration, technology, and security.
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations on technology strategies while considering various options and business needs.
  • Awareness of retail, supply chain, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries.
  • TOGAF, IASA or any other architecture-related certification is required.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


The Technical Architect provides the leadership, facilitation, analysis, and design tasks required for the development of an enterprise's technical architecture. They create deliverables that help develop target-state guidance (standards, guidelines, reference implementations) for evolving the technical infrastructure across the enterprise, to enable business strategy and deliver targeted business outcomes. They facilitate and orchestrate the delivery of targeted business outcomes through technical decisions.


  • Leads efforts to develop and maintain the architectural assets for the technical domain.
  • Sets an architecture direction for the technical domain that is aligned with business and IT goals.
  • Works with service management teams and solution architects to lower the total cost of ownership for IT capabilities.
  • Represents enterprise architecture by advocating and sharing knowledge.
  • Participates as a member of one or more architectural review boards (ARB) that ensure architecture quality and compliance.


  • Integration Architecture
  • Application Architecture
  • Technical Architecture
  • New Technology Innovation
  • Architecture Work
  • Modeling & Design:


Standard Setting:

  • Leads the creation of technical standards within area(s) of responsibility
  • Responsible for updating work products and communication when changes are required

title: Video Editor
description:
At CelEducation , we exist to help 1 billion people in this generation change their lives through online education—developing a better philosophy, modern skillsets, and learning how to make money online.

We are a fast-growing digital education company operating globally, and we’re looking for a Video Editor to join our high-performance tech team.


Role

We are hiring a Video Editor to join our high-performance creative team. This role is ideal for someone with a sharp eye for storytelling, strong technical editing skills, and a passion for creating emotionally compelling content that moves people to action.

You’ll be part of a team that values execution, clarity, and bold thinking. Whether you’re editing social media reels, course modules, or launch trailers—your work will directly contribute to transforming lives at scale.


Core Responsibilities

  • Edit both long-form and short-form video content for online courses, YouTube, and social media platforms (Reels, TikTok, Shorts, Ads)
  • Incorporate transitions, motion graphics, sound design, color grading, and subtitles to create compelling content
  • Follow creative briefs while also bringing your own vision to elevate the final product


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with content creators, marketers, and instructional designers to align messaging and visuals
  • Ensure final assets meet brand guidelines and performance objectives


Strategy & Impact

  • Develop and maintain efficient post-production workflows using cloud-based tools
  • Use engagement and performance data to iterate and improve video effectiveness
  • Propose creative storytelling angles and visual treatments that enhance retention and impact


Expected Outcomes

You will be successful in this role when:

  • 90%+ of projects are delivered on time and exceed internal quality benchmarks
  • Videos meet or exceed performance goals across YouTube, Meta, social media, and internal platforms.
  • You’ve systematized editing workflows that increase output capacity by at least 30% within 90 days.


Requirements

  • 2–4+ years of professional experience in video editing for online businesses, influencers, educational platforms, or social media content
  • Proven ability to create high-impact content that performs well across social and direct-response platforms
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and basic audio/sound mastering tools
  • Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Experience with YouTube channel editing, motion graphic templates, or podcast video content
  • Experience creating VSLs and editing performance-driven ad creatives for Facebook Ads and YouTube Ads. 


Compensation

Base Salary: US$ 750 – US$ 2,000 /month + Performance bonus

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and performance.


Location

Remote-first

We operate asynchronously across global time zones. Work from wherever you thrive.


Benefits

  • Flexible PTO + Company-wide Holidays
  • Remote work culture with performance-based autonomy
  • Collaborate with high-performers and creative thinkers
  • Be part of a mission-driven company helping millions transform their lives


CelEducation Core Values

We believe great people are at the center of every successful business. The right candidate for this role will not only understand these values—but live them.


Competitive Greatness – Be at your best when your best is needed. Love the challenge.

Sincere Candor – Say the hard thing. Receive the hard thing. Feedback fuels growth.

Unimpeachable Character – Act with integrity. Think long-term. Be someone others trust.

title: Creative Content & Concept Specialist - 51437
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a Creative Content & Concept Specialist with a background in film, video production, or screenplay writing to develop short-form video concepts and narrative structures. This role requires strong storytelling ability, visual thinking, and the skill to translate creative ideas into clear, structured briefs suitable for production and content development workflows.


Day-to-day responsibilities:

Develop short-form video concepts , creative storylines, and scene breakdowns across genres such as drama, comedy, lifestyle, and commercial content.

  • Write clear, production-ready descriptions of scenes, including character actions, camera framing, and sound or environmental cues.
  • Create structured documentation of concepts, ensuring clarity, visual coherence, and emotional consistency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative, production, and quality teams to refine ideas and maintain alignment with content guidelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, continuity, and realism in narrative flow and shot composition.


Manage multiple creative assignments with quick turnarounds while maintaining quality and originality.


Requirements:

Strong background in film, video production, or content creation — understanding of visual storytelling, camera work, and editing principles.

  • Excellent command of English with the ability to write visually descriptive and emotionally engaging content.
  • Knowledge of screenplay formatting and shot structuring (e.g., INT./EXT., scene timing, transitions).
  • Ability to visualize scenes and translate abstract ideas into practical, shootable concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, creative judgment, and consistency in tone and pacing.
  • Basic familiarity with structured writing formats (Markdown, JSON, TSV, or similar) is a plus.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Studies, Mass Communication, English, Media Production, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in creative writing, video production, content development, or screenplay writing.
  • Prior work in short films, advertising content, or storytelling-based projects is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working under tight timelines with collaborative, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for storytelling and cinematic content creation.
  • Strong visual and auditory imagination with attention to human detail.
  • Ability to self-direct, manage multiple creative briefs, and maintain high quality under deadlines.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated analytical challenge .
  • Once you clear the challenge, you will be redirected to a business writing assessment (English) followed by a language proficiency assessment.
  • Once you clear these online assessments, you are ready to go!


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Account Executive (Hunter) — Dados, Governança & IA
description:
Sobre a Apgar

Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Management, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com presença global e reconhecimento do mercado. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — de estratégia e governança até a implementação e operação de soluções de Analytics, MDM, Data Platform e AI — ajudando organizações a transformar dados em valor de negócio sustentável.


Além de serviços, temos ofertas proprietárias e aceleradores (como o ApgarIA para manufatura e supply chain (produção, previsão de demanda, agentes de IA, etc.) — e um portfólio robusto de casos e parcerias tecnológicas que ampliam o impacto nos clientes.


O que Oferecemos:


  • Ambiente global com equipes em 4 continentes
  • Empresa reconhecida internacionalmente, com metodologias próprias, ofertas de AI e stack tecnológica ampla para construir soluções de alto impacto.
  • Somos certificados Great Place to Work no Brasil ,
  • Oferecemos trilhas de formação contínua e coaching de carreira ; cultura colaborativa e meritocrática.
  • Pacote competitivo (salário + variável) e benefícios, com flexibilidade e possibilidade de atuação remota/híbrida.


Local de Trabalho: São Paulo ou Porto Alegre (modelo híbrido/remoto)


Responsabilidades:

Buscamos um(a) hunter nato(a) , apaixonado(a) por Account-Based Selling/Marketing (ABS/ABM) , para abrir novos logos enterprise (médias e grandes contas) que investem em Dados, Governança e IA . Você vai liderar o ciclo comercial completo, da prospecção executiva ao fechamento, orquestrando a proposta de valor da Apgar e conectando-a às dores reais dos clientes.


O que você vai vender


  • Consultoria para programas de Governança de Dados e Estratégia de Dados .
  • Apgar Pathfinder (nossa metodologia para aceleração e priorização de Dados e IA, quick wins/MVP e roadmap integrado entre valor de negócio, fundações de dados e plataforma).
  • Licenças de parceiros líderes de mercado (ex.: Soluções de MDM, Data Catalog, BI, Plataformas de Dados)
  • Serviços de Implementação de soluções MDM , Data Catalog e Plataformas de Dados (ex.: Databricks, Snowflake), além de Analytics & AI .
  • Produtos e Aceleradores Apgar
  • Serviços de Sustentação das soluções implementadas


Principais responsabilidades

  • Hunting com ABS/ABM: mapear contas-alvo, identificar buying centers (C-level, Data Leaders, TI, Operações) e conduzir abordagens multithread.
  • Prospecção executiva: construir relacionamento consultivo, qualificar dores (valor, risco, eficiência), definir hipóteses de valor e próximos passos.
  • Arquitetar a proposta de valor: liderar a coordenação de propostas (escopo, storytelling, casos de uso/ROI, investimento), orquestrando times técnicos para estimativas e demonstrações .
  • Pilotar o funil e forecast: gerir pipeline no CRM, definir e acompanhar plays com o(a) SDR (lista-alvo, mensagens, MQL→SQL), e garantir cadência de reuniões qualificadas.
  • Parcerias: trabalhar com parceiros tecnológicos na conquista de novos negócios.
  • Representar a Apgar em eventos do ecossistema de dados/IA .


Perfil que buscamos

  • Hunter com histórico consistente de abertura de novos logos enterprise em serviços consultoria de dados/IA, governança, MDM ou plataformas de dados.
  • Linguagem de negócio + fluência técnica : fala com CDO/CIO/COO e também debate em bom nível com equipes de dados e governança (sem precisar ser “mão no código”).
  • ABS/ABM practitioner : sabe montar account plans , mapear poder/influência, criar value hypotheses e navegar ciclos complexos.
  • Experiente na Orquestração de propostas ponta a ponta, com ownership da narrativa de valor e da negociação .
  • Networking ativo no ecossistema corporativo de Dados, TI e AI no Brasil/LatAm capaz de gerar pipeline.
  • Comunicação impecável (português) e inglês/espanhol valorizados para LatAm.


Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Casos vendidos/entregues envolvendo MDM (Customer/Product 360) , Catálogo de Dados, Programas Governança , Databricks/Snowflake , AI/ML .
  • Vivência em metodologias de valor e roadmap (ex.: priorização esforço×impacto, MVP, “from business value to foundations & platform”).
  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).


Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).
  • Pipeline saudável (cobertura, taxa de conversão, ciclo médio).
  • MVPs/PoVs vendidos com tese de valor clara (Pathfinder → MVP → roll-out).
  • Ativação de parceiros e geração de oportunidades conjuntas.



Apgar Group é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades e valoriza a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou deficiência.

  • ABS/ABM practitioner : sabe montar account plans , mapear poder/influência, criar value hypotheses e navegar ciclos complexos.
  • Experiente na Orquestração de propostas ponta a ponta, com ownership da narrativa de valor e da negociação .
  • Networking ativo no ecossistema corporativo de Dados, TI e AI no Brasil/LatAm capaz de gerar pipeline.
  • Comunicação impecável (português) e inglês/espanhol valorizados para LatAm.


Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Casos vendidos/entregues envolvendo MDM (Customer/Product 360) , Catálogo de Dados, Programas Governança , Databricks/Snowflake , AI/ML .
  • Vivência em metodologias de valor e roadmap (ex.: priorização esforço×impacto, MVP, “from business value to foundations & platform”).
  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).


Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).
  • Pipeline saudável (cobertura, taxa de conversão, ciclo médio).
  • MVPs/PoVs vendidos com tese de valor clara (Pathfinder → MVP → roll-out).
  • Ativação de parceiros e geração de oportunidades conjuntas.



Apgar Group é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades e valoriza a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou deficiência.

title: SR Desenvolvedor full stack (Node + React)
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento web usando React.js.
  • Experiência colaborando com times de backend utilizando Node.js.
  • Conhecimento profundo de JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Experiência sólida consumindo e integrando APIs RESTful.
  • Proficiência em versionamento com Git e fluxos de trabalho colaborativos (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
  • Experiência sólida construindo componentes modulares e reutilizáveis para aplicações React, com foco em alta manutenibilidade.
  • Experiência avançada com frameworks de gerenciamento de estado, como React Context, Zustand e Redux.
  • Metodologias ágeis.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente global.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Java/Golang Developer
description:
Work on backend components for enterprise-scale headend applications in the media domain. You will develop and maintain cloud-based microservices supporting high-volume workflows.


Responsibilities:

  • - Implement backend services using Java and Golang.
  • - Develop APIs and integrate event-driven systems.
  • - Participate in Agile development and CI/CD processes.
  • - Support operational tasks and troubleshoot issues.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Experience in Java and Golang development.
  • - Knowledge of microservices architecture and API design.
  • - Familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3).

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: Senior Email Marketing And Automation Specialist
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Email Marketing e Automação com experiência comprovada e conhecimentos técnicos, para atuar na gestão e otimização de campanhas.

Esta pessoa será responsável por impulsionar o engajamento e a maximização da receita por meio de estratégias de copys altamente otimizadas e entregabilidade através da gestão técnica de ips e senders.


I. Responsabilidades Chave e Escopo Estratégico Gestão de Automação:


Estruturar, implementar e gerenciar fluxos de automação de marketing complexos, incluindo estratégias de nutrição, retenção e reengajamento, visando a otimização do Lifetime Value (LTV). Monetização e Inbound:


Desenvolver e aplicar campanhas de Inbound Marketing, integrando o Email Marketing diretamente às estratégias de monetização de tráfego. Gestão Estratégica da Copy: Liderar a criação e otimização da Copywriting dos e-mails, com foco em objetivos de aumento de receita e métricas de engajamento. II. Proficiência Técnica e Entregabilidade (Requisito Fundamental) A pessoa deve possuir domínio técnico em: Plataformas de Email: Experiência com ferramentas de disparo e automação comparáveis a Hubspot, RD Station, SharpSpring, entre outras.


Entregabilidade: Conhecimento e experiência prática na gestão e configuração de domínios e IPs, incluindo a correta implementação e monitoramento de SPF, DKIM e DMARC, warm-ups e IP dedicado. Nuances de Infraestrutura: Entendimento técnico dos impactos da gestão de IPs e configurações de sender na saúde e taxa de entregabilidade de e-mails, bem como domínio das políticas de qualidade e boas práticas de mailing.


Otimização e Conversão: Especialização na utilização de testes A/B e multivariate para otimização contínua das taxas de abertura, clique e, crucialmente, de conversão e receita das campanhas. III. Habilidades de Liderança e Desenvolvimento Ter habilidades de compartilhar conhecimento e desenvolver pessoas que estão em fase de aprendizado. IV. Diferenciais Relevantes Serão valorizados conhecimentos ou experiências em: Utilizar ferramentas de IA como parte do processo diário.


Campanhas de Tráfego Pago e sua integração estratégica com o Email Marketing.

Modelos de Precificação e conhecimento do ecossistema de Publishers. Boa escrita e leitura em Inglês e/ou Espanhol.


Tipo de Contrato: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Modalidade de Trabalho: 100% remoto, autonomia para gerenciar sua rotina com flexibilidade de horário.


Benefícios:

Acesso a plataformas de aprendizado como Alura e Udemy, para apoiar seu crescimento contínuo

Cultura de aprendizado e trocas entre equipes multidisciplinares

Remuneração: A combinar, compatível com o nível sênior da posição.

A vaga é para uma empresa recém adquirida pelo iFood, eles possuem uma plataforma tecnológica voltada ao setor de food service, que digitaliza e automatiza toda a operação de restaurantes.   • Trabalhar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção da aplicação até a sua implantação;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Produto e Design para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficientes;
  • Escrever código de alta qualidade, bem documentado e testado;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias constantes nos processos e na arquitetura da aplicação;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e dar suporte técnico à equipe, sempre buscando o crescimento coletivo.

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (Django, Flask, etc.);
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com React.js;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL);
  • Habilidade em desenvolver APIs RESTful e trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a microserviços;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis;
  • Bom entendimento de conceitos de infraestrutura e implantação de aplicações (containerização, CI/CD, etc.);
  • Comunicação eficaz, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry. Please apply only if you have worked in this field.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $12.50 - $18 USD hourly / $2,000 - $2,880 monthly (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

title: Desenvolvedor Informix 4GL e Java Sênior
description:
O que procuramos?

Atribuições principais:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações utilizando Informix 4GL e Java;
  • Realizar análises técnicas e correções em sistemas legados;
  • Modelar, consultar e administrar bancos de dados Informix;
  • Apoiar na definição de soluções técnicas e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participar de integrações entre sistemas e migrações de dados;
  • Garantir a qualidade, segurança e performance das aplicações;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares (negócio, infraestrutura e QA).

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em Informix 4GL.
  • Domínio em banco de dados Informix (modelagem, tuning, SQL avançado, criação de scripts).
  • Vivência em análise e correção de sistemas legados de grande porte.
  • Conhecimentos em integrações via APIs, Shell Script e ambientes Unix/Linux.
  • Conhecimento em Java, com experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações robustas e escaláveis.
  • Experiência com Java Spring Boot para desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e serviços.
  • Conhecimento em Java EE para construção de soluções corporativas escaláveis e seguras.
  • Experiência na implementação e integração de sistemas com princípios de SOA.
  • Familiaridade com acesso a bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, utilizando Hibernate e JPA.
  • Experiência na implementação de testes unitários e de integração.
  • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git).
  • Experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis.

Localidade da posição:

Esta é uma posição Anywhere Office, você irá atuar 100% remoto.

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

- Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: Desenvolvedor Python Especialista
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções tecnológicas para o segmento de serviços , contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Ingles Fluente | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração:Dollar | Full-time


Requisitos Necessários

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, TI ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente)

Experiencia prática em desenvolvimento Fullstack com:

Proficiência em Python (Framework principal: Django, FastAPI, Graphql, ORM, Async programming, scripting e automação)

Experiência em microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos

Vivência com bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, etc.) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, ElasticSearch, etc.)

Experiência com CI/CD (Jenkins JTE)

Vivência em AWS Cloud e serviços gerenciados (ECS, S3, Lambda, SQS, Amplify, etc.)

Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes

Capacidade de produzir código limpo e sustentável em prazos agressivos

Forte conhecimento em Git

Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Requisitos Desejáveis

Ter atuado como Tech Lead ou participado de iniciativas que exigiram liderança técnica.

Contato próximo com processos de produto, trabalhando em conjunto com Product Managers e equipes multidisciplinares.


Responsabilidades

Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações web baseadas em AWS Cloud utilizando Python

Escrever código limpo, escalável e eficiente, seguindo boas práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento

Colaborar com o time na definição de requisitos, escopo e objetivos do projeto

Construir e manter APIs RESTful para integração em backend

Garantir a qualidade do software por meio de testes abrangentes, depuração e troubleshooting

Defender e aplicar práticas de TDD (Test-Driven Development) e testes automatizados

Otimizar aplicações para performance, escalabilidade e segurança

Participar de code reviews, cerimônias ágeis e sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento

Acompanhar tendências de mercado e novas tecnologias para manter as soluções atualizadas

Fornecer suporte técnico e resolver incidentes relacionados a aplicações

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who is confident in their skills and passionate about their craft. Our ideal candidate has multiple years of experience in frontend software development. You will be working with a group of highly skilled engineers to build the breakthrough solutions while ensuring the system is stable and scalable.


Responsibilities

  • Define and implement engineering best practices and frameworks to uplift our quality and resiliency.
  • Help estimate projects with deadlines, costs, and required resources.
  • Write highly scalable, testable, and resilient code to deliver engaging user experiences.
  • Create technical documentation to support code.
  • Champion CI/CD best practices and implementation.
  • Identify areas to improve and scale our architecture and application design.


Technology Requirements

  • Frontend Expertise : 5+ years of experience building modern JavaScript frontend web applications using frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Web Fundamentals : A solid understanding of semantic HTML, CSS, and core JavaScript principles.
  • Testing Methodologies : Proven experience working in a test-driven or behavior-driven environment.
  • API and System Design : Experience with REST APIs and Event Driven Systems.
  • Database Proficiency : Comfortable working with SQL databases (MySQL & Postgres).
  • Cloud Fundamentals : Experience with cloud platforms and their services (AWS, GCP, Azure).


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to communicate efficiently across the organization.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Our client is loong for a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join a global product-focused technology team responsible for building large-scale web platforms used by millions of users. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, engineering-driven environment with strong ownership, modern cloud architectures, and end-to-end autonomy.


What You Will Do

  • Design and build responsive, web-based applications and learning tools used at scale.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver impactful user-centric features.
  • Own the full software development lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, deployment, observability, and maintenance.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code and monitoring best practices to ensure highly reliable applications.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing engineering group built around autonomy and extreme ownership.


What You Bring

Mandatory Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java , ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Angular (preferred) or React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful services , microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , automated testing, and DevOps-oriented workflows.
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL).
  • Experience with AWS services for cloud-native application development.
  • Understanding of Docker and containerization concepts.
  • Experience with observability tools to monitor application health.
  • Solid understanding of backend engineering, with some experience across the full stack (front-end + backend).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Terraform (highly desirable).
  • Experience developing B2B or B2C product engineering solutions at scale.
  • Experience building accessible, high-performance, responsive web applications .
  • Knowledge of distributed caching solutions (e.g., Redis).
  • Experience deploying applications on Tomcat or similar application servers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Pleno
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder

Desenvolvimento Front-end:

  • Criar interfaces de usuário atraentes e responsivas utilizando Angular e JavaScript.
  • Colaborar com designers para implementar designs de alta qualidade.
  • Desenvolver componentes reutilizáveis que permitam uma experiência de usuário consistente.
  • Otimizar o desempenho da interface do usuário para garantir uma experiência suave e rápida.

Desenvolvimento Back-end:

  • Projetar e implementar APIs robustas e escaláveis utilizando frameworks e linguagens apropriados (C#, Python, Node.js, PHP e Laravel).
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados (SQL Server e MySQL) para armazenar e recuperar informações de maneira eficiente e segura.
  • Gerenciar autenticação e autorização para garantir a segurança dos dados e das funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com frameworks de aprendizado de máquina, especialmente TensorFlow , para integração de modelos de IA em aplicações web.

Colaboração e Desenvolvimento Ágil:

  • Uso de ferramentas como Jira e Git.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e revisão de sprint com a equipe.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com designers, desenvolvedores e outros membros da equipe para criar soluções integradas.
  • Contribuir ativamente para revisões de código e garantir a qualidade do código produzido.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web fullstack.
  • Experiência com TensorFlow (Python).
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação como JavaScript, C#, Python, PHP, etc.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com frameworks front-end (Angular) e/ou frameworks back-end (Laravel).
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Experiência em design responsivo e princípios de UI/UX.
  • Familiaridade com o versionamento de código usando sistemas como Git.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de testes.


Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Desenvolvedor Ruby on Rails Senior
